'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Chris Menzel DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
